title: Trove media play
description: One line of media/plays/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the play happened (started, for spans)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash); may be "" in sparse lines, the folder then names it

category.description: content type and the UI's filter axis: "music" | "podcast" | "audiobook" | "video" | "other"

subtitle.description: artist / show / director / site — the grouping key for top charts

device.description: device label the play came from, when known

seconds.description: seconds actually played, in seconds; 0 when unknown

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (for re-runnable imports)
